title: Reorder with order
summary: order moves flex items visually without touching the HTML.
explanation: Flex items are laid out by order first, then by source position. Every item starts at order: 0, and lower numbers come first, so order: -1 moves an item to the front.
This only changes the visual order. Keyboard focus and screen readers still follow the HTML, so use it for layout tweaks, not to reorder content that people navigate in sequence.
tryThis: Set .c to order: -2 so Preview comes first.
Remove order from .b: the cards return to HTML order.
